tasks.details: Create file_versions table with fields: id (UUID), attachment_id (UUID FK to attachments), version_number (INTEGER), file_name (VARCHAR), file_path (TEXT), file_size (BIGINT), file_hash (VARCHAR), version_comment (TEXT), created_by (UUID FK to users), created_at (TIMESTAMP), is_current (BOOLEAN). Implement versioning logic that automatically creates new versions when files are updated, maintaining the original attachment_id while storing each version separately. Build version history interface showing chronological list of versions with metadata (version number, upload date, file size, uploader, comments). Create rollback functionality allowing users to revert to previous versions by making the selected version current and creating a new version entry. Implement version comparison features showing differences between versions where applicable. Add version cleanup policies to manage storage usage by automatically archiving or deleting old versions based on company settings. Ensure proper permission checks for version access and rollback operations based on user roles and company boundaries. Integrate version controls into existing file attachment interfaces on tickets and projects.
tasks.testStrategy: Test version creation when files are updated, ensuring proper version numbering and metadata tracking. Verify version history display shows correct chronological order with accurate file information and user details. Test rollback functionality by reverting to previous versions and confirming file content and metadata are correctly restored. Validate permission-based access to version history and rollback operations across different user roles. Test version cleanup policies with automated archiving and deletion of old versions. Verify file versioning works correctly with various file types and sizes. Test edge cases including rapid successive updates, concurrent version creation, and storage failure scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement File Search and Filtering Capabilities
tasks.description: Build comprehensive file search and filtering system allowing users to search files by name, type, date, and content with advanced filtering options across tickets, projects, and user uploads.
tasks.details: Implement file search functionality by creating a dedicated search interface in components/ui/file-search.tsx with search input field, filter dropdowns, and results display. Build backend search service in lib/services/file-search.ts supporting full-text search on file names, metadata, and descriptions using PostgreSQL's full-text search capabilities or Supabase's search functions. Create advanced filtering options including file type filters (documents, images, videos), date range pickers, file size filters, uploader filters, and associated ticket/project filters. Implement search indexing for file metadata and content using database indexes on frequently searched fields (file_name, mime_type, created_at, uploaded_by). Build search results interface with sortable columns, pagination, and thumbnail previews for supported file types. Add search autocomplete and suggestions based on previous searches and popular file names. Implement search history and saved searches functionality for frequent users. Create search analytics to track popular search terms and optimize search performance. Ensure search respects company-level data isolation and user permissions, filtering results based on user access to associated tickets and projects.
tasks.testStrategy: Test file search functionality with various search terms including partial matches, special characters, and edge cases. Verify filtering options work correctly individually and in combination, ensuring proper result filtering. Test search performance with large datasets and verify database indexes are being utilized effectively. Test search autocomplete and suggestions with different user input patterns. Verify search results respect user permissions and company data isolation by testing with different user roles and companies. Test pagination and sorting functionality in search results. Verify search works correctly across different file types and metadata fields.

tasks.title: Create file sharing system with expiring links and access controls
tasks.description: Build a comprehensive file sharing system that allows users to generate secure, time-limited links for file access with granular permission controls and audit logging.
tasks.details: Create shared_links table with fields: id (UUID), attachment_id (UUID FK to attachments), shared_by (UUID FK to users), company_id (UUID FK to companies), link_token (VARCHAR unique), expires_at (TIMESTAMP), access_type (ENUM: view, download), password_hash (VARCHAR, nullable), max_downloads (INTEGER, nullable), download_count (INTEGER default 0), is_active (BOOLEAN default true), created_at, updated_at. Implement link generation service that creates cryptographically secure tokens using crypto.randomBytes() and stores expiration times. Build access control middleware that validates tokens, checks expiration, enforces download limits, and logs access attempts. Create share link management interface allowing users to generate links with configurable expiration times (1 hour, 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, custom), set password protection, limit download counts, and view/revoke active links. Implement public file access endpoint /api/public/files/[token] that validates shared links and serves files without authentication. Build audit logging system tracking all file access attempts with IP addresses, user agents, and timestamps. Add email notification system for link creators when files are accessed or download limits are reached. Implement link analytics showing access statistics and download history.
tasks.testStrategy: Test shared link generation with various expiration times and access controls including password protection and download limits. Verify link validation middleware properly checks token validity, expiration times, and enforces access restrictions. Test public file access endpoint with valid and invalid tokens, expired links, and password-protected shares. Verify audit logging captures all access attempts with accurate metadata including IP addresses and timestamps. Test link management interface for creating, viewing, editing, and revoking shared links. Validate email notifications are sent for file access events and download limit breaches. Test edge cases including simultaneous downloads, expired link access attempts, and revoked link behavior. Verify security measures prevent token enumeration attacks and unauthorized file access.

tasks.title: Implement bulk file operations for download and delete
tasks.description: Build comprehensive bulk file operations allowing users to select multiple files and perform batch download or delete operations with progress tracking and confirmation dialogs.
tasks.details: Implement bulk file operations by creating a file selection system with checkboxes for individual files and select-all functionality in the file management interface. Build bulk download functionality using JSZip library to create zip archives of selected files with proper filename handling and download progress tracking. Implement bulk delete operations with confirmation modal showing file count and names, ensuring proper cleanup from both database and Supabase storage. Create batch operation progress indicators showing completion status for each file operation with error handling for individual failures. Add keyboard shortcuts for select all (Ctrl/Cmd+A) and bulk operations (Delete key for deletion). Implement proper permission checks ensuring users can only perform bulk operations on files they have access to within their company scope. Create bulk operation audit logging to track who performed what operations on which files. Add undo functionality for bulk delete operations within a short time window using temporary soft delete before permanent removal.
tasks.testStrategy: Test file selection functionality including individual checkboxes, select-all toggle, and keyboard shortcuts across different file types and quantities. Verify bulk download creates proper zip archives with correct file contents and handles large file sets without memory issues. Test bulk delete confirmation modal displays correct file information and properly removes files from both database and storage. Verify progress tracking shows accurate completion status and handles individual file failures gracefully. Test permission enforcement ensuring users cannot perform bulk operations on files outside their access scope. Validate audit logging captures all bulk operations with proper user attribution and timestamp information.

tasks.title: Build company storage quota management system
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive storage quota management for companies including usage tracking, limits enforcement, quota alerts, and administrative controls for storage allocation.
tasks.details: Create storage_quotas table with fields: id (UUID), company_id (UUID FK), total_quota_bytes (BIGINT), used_storage_bytes (BIGINT default 0), warning_threshold_percent (INTEGER default 80), alert_threshold_percent (INTEGER default 90), is_unlimited (BOOLEAN default false), last_calculated_at (TIMESTAMP), created_at, updated_at. Implement storage calculation service that aggregates file sizes across all company attachments and updates usage metrics. Build storage quota enforcement middleware that prevents file uploads when quota is exceeded. Create storage usage dashboard component showing current usage, quota limits, and visual progress indicators with color-coded warnings (green < 80%, yellow 80-90%, red > 90%). Implement automated storage calculation job that runs periodically to update usage statistics and send quota warnings via email notifications. Build admin interface for super admins to set and modify company storage quotas with bulk operations and usage analytics. Create storage optimization tools including duplicate file detection and cleanup suggestions. Implement storage alerts system that notifies company admins when approaching or exceeding quotas. Add storage usage charts and historical tracking for capacity planning. Ensure proper indexing for efficient storage calculations on large datasets.
tasks.testStrategy: Test storage quota table creation with proper constraints and relationships to companies. Verify storage calculation service accurately aggregates file sizes across all company attachments and handles large datasets efficiently. Test quota enforcement prevents uploads when limits exceeded and allows uploads within quota. Validate storage dashboard displays accurate usage statistics with proper color coding and responsive design. Test automated calculation job runs correctly and updates usage metrics without performance impact. Verify admin quota management interface allows proper quota setting with validation and bulk operations. Test storage optimization tools correctly identify duplicates and provide actionable cleanup suggestions. Validate alert system sends timely notifications to appropriate company administrators. Test edge cases including quota changes, file deletions, and concurrent uploads affecting storage calculations.

tasks.title: Implement file retention policies and automatic cleanup
tasks.description: Build comprehensive file retention system with automated cleanup policies, storage optimization, and lifecycle management for company files and attachments.
tasks.details: Create file_retention_policies table with fields: id (UUID), company_id (UUID FK), policy_name (VARCHAR), file_type_filter (VARCHAR array), retention_days (INTEGER), auto_delete_enabled (BOOLEAN), created_by (UUID FK to users), created_at, updated_at. Implement retention policy engine that scans files based on age, file type, and company policies, marking files for deletion and providing grace periods. Build automatic cleanup service using cron jobs or scheduled functions to permanently delete files past retention period, with proper audit logging in file_deletion_log table. Create retention policy management UI allowing company admins to configure policies for different file types (documents, images, logs, exports) with preview of affected files. Implement storage optimization features including duplicate file detection using file hashes, compression for older files, and archival to cold storage. Add retention policy dashboard showing storage savings, cleanup statistics, and policy effectiveness metrics. Build notification system to alert administrators before bulk deletions and provide restoration capabilities within grace periods. Ensure integration with existing file metadata system and respect company storage quotas during cleanup operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test retention policy table creation with proper foreign key relationships and validation constraints. Verify retention policy engine correctly identifies files for cleanup based on age and type filters across different companies. Test automatic cleanup service handles large datasets efficiently without performance degradation and properly logs all deletion activities. Validate retention policy UI allows proper configuration and preview functionality with accurate file count estimates. Test storage optimization features including duplicate detection accuracy and file compression effectiveness. Verify notification system sends appropriate alerts before deletions and restoration functionality works within grace periods. Test integration with storage quota system ensures cleanup operations update quota usage correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Automatic File Compression and Optimization
tasks.description: Build an automated file compression and optimization system that reduces file sizes during upload and storage while maintaining quality, with support for multiple file types and configurable compression settings.
tasks.details: Implement comprehensive file compression system by creating a file processing service in lib/services/file-compression.ts that handles automatic compression for images (JPEG, PNG, WebP), documents (PDF), and other file types using libraries like sharp for image processing and pdf-lib for PDF optimization. Build compression middleware that integrates with the existing file upload flow, automatically detecting file types and applying appropriate compression algorithms based on configurable settings. Create compression settings interface allowing administrators to configure compression levels, quality settings, and file size thresholds per file type. Implement progressive compression with multiple quality levels (high, medium, low) and automatic fallback for unsupported formats. Add file size validation and automatic compression triggers when files exceed specified thresholds. Create batch compression functionality for existing files with progress tracking and resume capabilities. Implement file deduplication using file hashes to prevent storing duplicate compressed files. Add compression metrics tracking including original size, compressed size, and compression ratio for analytics. Create background job system for processing large files without blocking the upload interface. Ensure compressed files maintain proper metadata and file associations with tickets, projects, and users.
tasks.testStrategy: Test compression functionality with various file types and sizes to verify proper compression ratios and quality preservation. Verify compression settings interface allows proper configuration of quality levels and thresholds. Test automatic compression triggers during file upload with different file sizes and types. Validate batch compression functionality with progress tracking and resume capabilities. Test file deduplication to ensure duplicate files are properly identified and handled. Verify compression metrics are accurately tracked and reported. Test background processing system handles large files without impacting application performance. Ensure compressed files maintain proper relationships with associated tickets, projects, and users. Test compression rollback functionality if original files need to be restored.

tasks.title: Set up CDN integration for file delivery performance
tasks.description: Implement CDN integration to improve file delivery performance by configuring content distribution network for static file assets, implementing cache headers, and optimizing file serving through edge locations.
tasks.details: Implement CDN integration by configuring a CDN service (CloudFront, Cloudflare, or Vercel Edge Network) to serve files from Supabase Storage through edge locations for improved global performance. Create CDN configuration service in lib/services/cdn.ts with functions to generate CDN URLs, manage cache invalidation, and handle CDN-specific headers. Modify existing file serving endpoints in app/api/files/ to support CDN URLs and implement proper cache headers (Cache-Control, ETag, Last-Modified) for optimal caching behavior. Build CDN URL generation utilities that automatically convert Supabase Storage URLs to CDN URLs based on file type and access patterns. Implement cache invalidation mechanisms for file updates and deletions, ensuring CDN cache remains synchronized with actual file changes. Configure CDN settings for different file types with appropriate TTL values - long caching for static assets like images and documents, shorter caching for frequently updated files. Add CDN health monitoring and fallback mechanisms to serve files directly from Supabase Storage if CDN is unavailable. Create configuration options for CDN enablement per company or file type, allowing flexible deployment strategies. Implement CDN analytics integration to track performance metrics and cache hit ratios.
tasks.testStrategy: Test CDN URL generation with various file types and verify proper conversion from Supabase Storage URLs to CDN URLs. Verify cache headers are properly set for different file types with appropriate TTL values and validate browser caching behavior. Test file delivery performance by comparing load times between direct Supabase Storage access and CDN delivery from multiple geographic locations. Test cache invalidation by uploading new versions of files and verifying CDN serves updated content within expected timeframes. Verify CDN fallback mechanisms work correctly when CDN service is unavailable or experiencing issues. Test CDN analytics integration and performance monitoring to ensure proper metrics collection. Validate CDN configuration options work correctly for different companies and file types. Test edge cases including large file downloads, concurrent requests, and bandwidth limitations through CDN.

tasks.title: Create Comments and Activity System
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive commenting system for tickets and projects with rich text editor, @mentions, comment threads, and activity feed with real-time updates.
tasks.details: Create comments table with fields: id (UUID), content (TEXT), content_html (TEXT for rich text), parent_comment_id (UUID FK for replies), ticket_id (UUID FK, nullable), project_id (UUID FK, nullable), author_id (UUID FK to users), company_id (UUID FK), mentions (TEXT[] for @mentioned users), created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (soft delete). Implement rich text editor using TipTap or similar with @mention functionality that searches users within company. Build comment threads UI with nested replies, expand/collapse functionality, and proper indentation. Create activity_feed table with fields: id (UUID), entity_type (ENUM: ticket, project, comment), entity_id (UUID), action_type (ENUM: created, updated, deleted, commented, assigned, status_changed), actor_id (UUID FK to users), company_id (UUID FK), activity_data (JSONB), created_at. Implement activity tracking service that logs all user actions across tickets, projects, and comments. Build activity feed UI component showing chronological list of activities with user avatars, action descriptions, and timestamps. Integrate with real-time notification system for live comment updates and activity feed refresh. Add comment permissions based on user roles and ticket/project access. Implement comment editing with edit history tracking, and comment deletion with audit trail. Create @mention notification system that sends real-time notifications to mentioned users.
tasks.testStrategy: Test comment CRUD operations including creation, editing, deletion, and soft delete functionality with proper authorization checks. Verify rich text editor functionality including formatting, @mention autocomplete, and HTML sanitization. Test comment thread display with nested replies and proper indentation. Test activity feed generation for all tracked actions (ticket updates, project changes, comment creation) with accurate timestamps and user information. Verify real-time updates for comments and activity feed across multiple browser sessions. Test @mention functionality including user search, notification delivery, and permission validation. Test comment permissions ensuring users can only comment on tickets/projects they have access to. Verify activity data JSON structure contains all necessary information for display. Test comment editing history tracking and deletion audit trails.

tasks.title: Implement Real-time Collaboration Features
tasks.description: Create live presence indicators showing who's viewing tickets/projects, real-time updates when others make changes, collaborative editing indicators, and typing indicators in comments using Supabase Realtime for WebSocket connections.
tasks.details: Implement comprehensive real-time collaboration system by creating presence tracking service in lib/services/presence.ts using Supabase Realtime channels to track user presence on tickets and projects with heartbeat mechanism and automatic cleanup on disconnect. Build live presence indicators component showing user avatars with online status badges, displaying who's currently viewing each ticket/project with real-time updates when users join/leave. Create collaborative editing indicators by tracking active editors on forms and comments, showing typing indicators with user identification and debounced input detection. Implement real-time change notifications using Supabase Realtime to broadcast ticket updates (status, assignee, priority changes), comment additions/edits, and time tracking activities to all connected users viewing the same resource. Build conflict resolution system for simultaneous edits with optimistic updates and rollback capabilities. Create WebSocket connection management service with automatic reconnection, connection pooling, and error handling. Add visual indicators for real-time events including toast notifications for changes, live update badges, and smooth UI transitions for collaborative actions. Integrate with existing notification system (Task 42) to ensure seamless real-time experience across all collaboration features.
tasks.testStrategy: Test presence tracking by opening same ticket/project in multiple browser windows and verifying user avatars appear/disappear correctly with real-time updates. Test collaborative editing indicators by having multiple users edit forms simultaneously and confirming typing indicators display with proper user identification. Verify real-time change notifications by making ticket updates in one browser and confirming immediate updates appear in other connected browsers without page refresh. Test WebSocket connection stability including automatic reconnection after network interruptions and proper cleanup on browser close. Test conflict resolution by having multiple users edit same field simultaneously and verifying proper handling of conflicting changes. Test performance with multiple concurrent users and verify system remains responsive with proper connection management and resource cleanup.

tasks.title: Build Team Communication System
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive team chat/messaging system with project-specific discussion boards, direct messaging, message notifications, file attachments, and real-time communication features.
tasks.details: Implement comprehensive team communication system by creating messages table with fields: id (UUID), content (TEXT), content_html (TEXT for rich formatting), message_type (ENUM: 'direct', 'project_board', 'ticket_thread'), sender_id (UUID FK to users), recipient_id (UUID FK, nullable for direct messages), project_id (UUID FK, nullable for project boards), ticket_id (UUID FK, nullable for ticket discussions), company_id (UUID FK), parent_message_id (UUID FK for replies), attachments (JSON for file references), read_by (JSON array tracking read status), created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (soft delete). Build real-time messaging interface using Supabase Realtime channels for instant message delivery and typing indicators. Create project discussion boards with threaded conversations, pinned messages, and topic organization. Implement direct messaging system with user search, conversation history, and online status indicators. Build message search functionality with full-text search across content, filtering by date range, sender, and message type. Integrate file attachment system allowing users to share documents, images, and files within messages with preview capabilities. Create comprehensive notification system for new messages, mentions, and unread count badges with real-time updates. Implement message formatting with rich text editor supporting mentions, links, and basic formatting. Build message history with pagination, message editing/deletion capabilities, and proper authorization ensuring users can only access messages within their company scope and appropriate projects.
tasks.testStrategy: Test real-time messaging functionality by opening multiple browser sessions and verifying instant message delivery, typing indicators, and online status updates. Test message search across different content types, date ranges, and filtering options ensuring accurate results and performance with large message volumes. Verify file attachment functionality including upload, preview, download, and proper storage integration with virus scanning. Test notification system including real-time delivery, unread count updates, mention detection, and email notification triggers. Test project discussion boards with proper access controls ensuring users can only access boards for projects they're members of. Verify direct messaging with conversation management, message threading, and read status tracking. Test message formatting including rich text editor functionality, mention autocomplete, and HTML sanitization. Test authorization thoroughly ensuring complete message isolation between companies and proper project-level access controls with role-based permissions.

tasks.title: Create Integration Hub with Slack, Email-to-Ticket, Webhooks, and REST API
tasks.description: Build comprehensive integration platform with Slack notifications, email-to-ticket system, webhook infrastructure for external integrations, and REST API for third-party tools with OAuth2 authentication.
tasks.details: Implement Integration Hub by creating integrations table with fields: id (UUID), company_id (UUID FK), integration_type (ENUM: slack, email, webhook, api), name (VARCHAR), configuration (JSONB), oauth_tokens (JSONB encrypted), webhook_url (TEXT), webhook_secret (VARCHAR), is_active (BOOLEAN), created_by (UUID FK), created_at, updated_at. Build Slack integration with OAuth2 flow using Slack Web API - create /api/integrations/slack/oauth for authorization callback, implement notification posting to Slack channels for ticket updates, user assignments, and project milestones. Create email-to-ticket system with dedicated email parsing service - implement email webhook endpoint /api/integrations/email/inbound, parse email headers for sender identification, extract ticket references from subject lines, create tickets from email content with proper company association. Build webhook system for external integrations - create webhook_events table for event logging, implement webhook delivery queue with retry logic, provide webhook endpoint registration interface, support event filtering and custom payloads. Develop REST API for third-party tools with endpoints: GET/POST /api/v1/tickets, GET/POST /api/v1/projects, GET /api/v1/users, GET /api/v1/time-entries with proper rate limiting, authentication via API keys, and comprehensive error handling. Implement OAuth2 server functionality for secure third-party authentication using authorization code flow with PKCE. Create integration management UI for admins to configure and monitor all integrations with connection status, event logs, and configuration forms.
tasks.testStrategy: Test Slack integration OAuth2 flow and message posting functionality with various notification types. Verify email-to-ticket parsing with different email formats, attachments, and sender scenarios. Test webhook delivery system with retry logic, failure handling, and event filtering. Validate REST API endpoints with proper authentication, rate limiting, and CRUD operations. Test OAuth2 server implementation with authorization flows and token management. Verify integration management UI functionality including configuration updates and status monitoring.

tasks.title: Implement Workflow Automation Engine
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive workflow automation system with custom workflows, trigger-based actions, approval workflows, custom fields, and a visual workflow designer UI with execution engine.
tasks.details: Implement comprehensive workflow automation engine by creating workflow schema tables: workflows (id, name, description, company_id, trigger_type, conditions, actions, status, created_by), workflow_steps (id, workflow_id, step_type, step_order, configuration, conditions), workflow_executions (id, workflow_id, trigger_data, status, started_at, completed_at, error_message), and workflow_approvals (id, workflow_id, execution_id, approver_id, status, approved_at). Build trigger system supporting ticket events (created, updated, assigned, status_changed), time-based triggers (scheduled, recurring), and user actions. Create action engine for auto-assignment, status transitions, notifications, field updates, and approval requests. Implement visual workflow designer using React Flow or similar library with drag-drop interface for creating workflows with conditional branches, approval nodes, and action nodes. Build workflow execution engine with queue processing, error handling, retry logic, and audit logging. Create custom fields system allowing dynamic form fields with validation rules and conditional visibility. Implement approval workflow system with multi-step approvals, delegation, and timeout handling. Add workflow templates for common scenarios and workflow analytics dashboard.
tasks.testStrategy: Test workflow creation through visual designer with various trigger types and action combinations. Verify trigger detection and workflow execution with different ticket scenarios and time-based triggers. Test approval workflows with multiple approvers, delegation scenarios, and timeout handling. Verify custom fields creation, validation, and conditional display logic. Test workflow execution engine with concurrent workflows, error scenarios, and retry mechanisms. Validate workflow analytics and audit logging functionality. Test workflow templates import/export and sharing capabilities.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Task Master Collaboration Features System
tasks.description: Build a comprehensive collaboration system with comments/activity tracking, real-time collaboration, team communication, integration hub, and workflow automation engine to enhance project coordination and team productivity.
tasks.details: Implement comprehensive collaboration features by creating a comments and activity system with task_comments table including task_id, user_id, comment_text, and timestamps, and task_activities table for tracking all task changes, assignments, and status updates. Build real-time collaboration using WebSocket connections or Server-Sent Events for live updates on task changes, comments, and user presence indicators. Create team communication features with @mentions in comments, notification system for team updates, and activity feeds showing recent project activities. Develop integration hub with webhook endpoints for external tool integrations (GitHub, Slack, Jira), API connectors for popular project management tools, and custom integration builder interface. Implement workflow automation engine with rule-based triggers for task transitions, automatic assignment rules based on workload or expertise, scheduled task creation and updates, and custom workflow templates. Add collaboration analytics with team activity metrics, collaboration frequency tracking, and productivity insights dashboard. Ensure all features integrate seamlessly with existing notification system and maintain real-time synchronization across all connected users.
tasks.testStrategy: Test comments system by creating, editing, and deleting task comments, verifying proper user attribution and timestamps. Test real-time collaboration by opening multiple browser sessions and verifying live updates for task changes, new comments, and user presence. Test team communication features by using @mentions and verifying notification delivery, testing activity feeds for accurate recent activity display. Test integration hub by setting up webhook endpoints and verifying external tool integration functionality, testing API connectors with sample external tools. Test workflow automation by creating automation rules and verifying proper trigger execution, testing automatic assignment rules under various workload scenarios. Test collaboration analytics by generating team activity reports and verifying accurate metrics calculation. Perform load testing with multiple concurrent users to ensure real-time features maintain performance under collaboration load.

tasks.title: Implement TOTP-based Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
tasks.description: Add comprehensive TOTP-based two-factor authentication system with secret generation, QR code creation for authenticator apps, verification logic, and seamless integration with existing authentication flow.
tasks.details: Implement TOTP 2FA system by first installing required dependencies (otplib, qrcode) and creating TOTP service in lib/services/totp.ts with functions for secret generation using crypto.randomBytes(), QR code generation with otplib.authenticator.keyuri(), and TOTP verification using otplib.authenticator.verify(). Add totp_secret and totp_enabled fields to users table with appropriate database migration. Create 2FA setup flow with /app/auth/setup-2fa page displaying QR code and manual entry backup codes, verification step requiring user to enter TOTP code to confirm setup, and backup recovery codes generation stored encrypted in database. Build 2FA verification component for login flow that conditionally appears after password verification when totp_enabled is true, integrates with existing Supabase Auth using custom hooks, and includes backup code entry option. Update existing auth middleware and API routes to check 2FA verification status, modify sign-in process to redirect to 2FA verification when enabled, and add 2FA management to user profile settings with disable option requiring password confirmation. Implement proper error handling, rate limiting for verification attempts, and secure secret storage using encryption.
tasks.testStrategy: Test TOTP secret generation and QR code creation by setting up 2FA with Google Authenticator or Authy apps and verifying codes work correctly. Test complete 2FA setup flow including QR code scanning, manual secret entry, verification code confirmation, and backup codes generation. Verify login flow integration by testing sign-in with 2FA enabled users, ensuring proper redirection to verification step and successful completion. Test backup recovery codes functionality including generation, storage, and usage for account recovery. Test 2FA management features including enabling/disabling from profile settings, requiring password confirmation, and proper cleanup of TOTP data. Test security measures including rate limiting on verification attempts, proper error messages without information leakage, and secure storage of TOTP secrets. Test edge cases including expired codes, invalid codes, multiple rapid verification attempts, and account lockout scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement SMS-based Two-Factor Authentication option
tasks.description: Add comprehensive SMS-based 2FA system with phone number verification, SMS provider integration (Twilio/AWS SNS), SMS code generation and verification, and fallback options for enhanced account security.
tasks.details: Implement SMS-based 2FA system by first installing SMS provider dependencies (twilio SDK or aws-sdk for SNS) and creating SMS service in lib/services/sms.ts with functions for phone number validation using libphonenumber-js, SMS code generation using crypto.randomBytes(), and SMS sending via Twilio or AWS SNS. Add phone_number, phone_verified, sms_2fa_enabled, and backup_codes fields to users table with appropriate database migration. Create phone verification flow with /app/auth/verify-phone page for initial phone number setup, SMS code entry interface, and verification confirmation. Build SMS 2FA setup flow integrated with existing 2FA setup page, allowing users to choose between TOTP and SMS methods or enable both. Implement SMS code generation and verification logic with 6-digit codes, 5-minute expiration, and rate limiting (max 3 attempts per 5 minutes). Create fallback options including backup codes generation (10 single-use codes), account recovery via email for SMS delivery failures, and admin override capabilities. Update login flow to support SMS verification step when SMS 2FA is enabled, with code entry interface and resend functionality. Add SMS settings to user preferences for managing phone number, enabling/disabling SMS 2FA, and regenerating backup codes. Implement comprehensive error handling for SMS delivery failures, invalid phone numbers, expired codes, and rate limit exceeded scenarios. Ensure proper audit logging for all SMS 2FA activities including setup, verification attempts, and backup code usage.
tasks.testStrategy: Test phone number verification by adding various international phone number formats and verifying SMS codes are received and validated correctly. Test complete SMS 2FA setup flow including phone number entry, SMS verification, backup codes generation, and integration with existing TOTP 2FA system. Verify login flow with SMS 2FA enabled including code generation, SMS delivery, verification, and fallback to backup codes when SMS fails. Test rate limiting by attempting multiple SMS requests and verification attempts, ensuring proper error messages and cooldown periods. Test SMS provider integration by sending codes through both Twilio and AWS SNS (if both implemented) and verifying delivery success rates. Test backup codes functionality including generation, one-time usage, and account recovery scenarios. Verify error handling for various failure scenarios including SMS delivery failures, invalid phone numbers, expired codes, and network issues. Test security measures including code expiration, rate limiting, and audit logging for all SMS 2FA activities.

tasks.title: Generate and manage 2FA backup codes
tasks.description: Create secure backup code generation system, store encrypted backup codes, implement code verification and usage tracking, provide download/print options for users.
tasks.details: Implement comprehensive 2FA backup codes system by first creating backup_codes table with fields: id (UUID), user_id (UUID FK), code_hash (VARCHAR), used_at (TIMESTAMP NULL), created_at (TIMESTAMP). Create backup codes service in lib/services/backup-codes.ts with functions for generating 10 random 8-digit codes using crypto.randomBytes(), hashing codes with bcrypt before storage, and verification logic that marks codes as used. Add backup codes generation during 2FA setup flow, automatically creating codes when TOTP is enabled. Build backup codes display interface showing codes in a printable/downloadable format with clear usage instructions and warnings about security. Implement backup code verification in login flow as alternative to TOTP when primary 2FA method fails. Create backup codes management interface allowing users to regenerate codes (invalidating old ones), view usage history, and download/print codes securely. Add rate limiting for backup code usage attempts and comprehensive audit logging. Ensure codes are stored as hashes only, never in plaintext, and implement proper cleanup of used codes.
